name: BunkerNet
description: Share threat data with other BunkerWeb instances via BunkerNet.

BUNKERNET_FILTER_HEADERS.help: Limit what a BunkerNet report carries. The Cookie, Authorization and Proxy-Authorization request headers, and the values ModSecurity matched in them or in cookies, are never sent. When yes, only the User-Agent, Accept, Accept-Encoding, Accept-Language, Content-Type and Content-Length request headers are sent, and the values matched in any header are blanked. When no, the other request headers are sent as they are.
BUNKERNET_FILTER_HEADERS.label: Filter reported headers
